Touch: left pad = pitch/roll (drag down = nose up) · right slider = throttle · buttons for gear/flaps/brake/spoiler/autopilot.
Keys: SPACE fire missile (red FIRE button) · throttle >92% = afterburner · W/S pitch · A/D roll · Q/E rudder · ↑/↓ throttle · G gear · F flaps · B brake · X spoilers · P autopilot (I/K alt, J/L hdg, U/O spd) · C cam · M mute · N next airport · +/- map zoom · 1-4 weather · R reset

F-22 Raptor model: “F-22 Raptor – Fighter Jet – Free” by bohmerang (Sketchfab), CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

Takeoff: flaps 1, full throttle, keep centerline with rudder, at ~125-135 kt pull back gently (rotate ~8°), raise gear once climbing.
Landing: gear down, flaps 3, ~135-140 kt, hold the 3° glide slope (HUD), flare below 15 m by easing the nose up, touch down < 3 m/s, cut throttle, brake + spoilers.
